l2_shape.detail: the 8 live B2B landers are ONE distribution experiment with 8 arms, not 8 products; build only the arm that converts; no new verticals until one converts; no Papermark/Documenso forks (AGPL-3.0 network-source obligation)

distribution_experiments.hypothesis: cold email from a warmed domain to HN-sourced contract leads produces buying signal
distribution_experiments.success: >=1 reply naming a price, date, or scope question
distribution_experiments.falsifier: 0 replies of any kind from n=40 => cold email to HN-sourced contract leads is DEAD for this stack
distribution_experiments.power_note: at 5-10% reply rate, n=40 gives 87-98% chance of >=1 reply if the offer works

distribution_experiments.hypothesis: at least one of the 8 B2B verticals has cold-reachable demand
distribution_experiments.falsifier: 0 conversions across all 8 landers after 8 posts => cold Reddit self-post is DEAD as a B2B micro-SaaS channel and the 8-vertical shotgun is falsified as a demand-discovery method
distribution_experiments.power_note: weak for ranking verticals, strong for binary any-demand; do NOT conclude a vertical is dead from n=1 post
distribution_experiments.risk: ban risk - several subreddits prohibit self-promotion; rules-check each before posting

distribution_experiments.hypothesis: the medical-dictation utility can earn HN attention cold
distribution_experiments.falsifier: <5 upvotes and <20 visits => HN Show is DEAD as a cold-launch channel for this studio's artifacts at current polish
distribution_experiments.power_note: n=1 high variance; a null here is WEAK evidence, hence rank 3
